text: My favorite thing here is the vegan broth. Sometimes with the soups the veggies aren't cooked. They also haven't added nutrition facts yet which is disappointing given they have such a simple menu.

I've been to this location twice, and I have nothing but great things to say.  Is the wait time a bit lengthy at night? Yes.  But the customer service compared to the Hermitage location is outstanding.  Our last server, Dacia, was perfection.  She was attentive, answered all of our questions, and was engaging during the entire time we were there.  I am sure there have been some customers who've had legitimate issues, but I will go to this location every time.

Excellent experience. We were there a little before normal dinner time on a Saturday and got a little worried because there was no one upfront. They had been getting a large group table ready. We were seated and the waiter was fast, courteous and helped me choose between a few things. I had a 4Hands stout, the grilled salmon and my fiancé had nachos with chicken and lobster bisque soup. The food was outstanding. The Nachos weren't salty and the chicken had something like a dry rub on it. The salmon was cooked really well, with a  miso ginger sauce, on a bed of edamame rice and some lightly pickled veggies. It was just the right mix of tangy with only a hint of sweet. He remembered lemons for the water and kept us with water. All in all, this was a great experience. The place was packed by the time we left.
The atmosphere is nice, the place is well decorated. Prices are high for the quality of the food.

Discovered Peno on Yelp!  The service was awesome and everyone was really friendly.  We arrived about 8:45 on a Friday night and were seated immediately on the patio.  The bread and our Pizza was amazing.   I'd go as far as to say it was the best pizza that I had in a long time.  We'll definitely visit again in the future.

Tucked away between two seemingly mundane buildings, Knead Bagels is one of the best bagel spots in town! We came here not knowing what to expect and left with our stomachs jumping for joy. The bagels are DELICIOUS here, although slightly pricey for a bagel. I got the special (ham, egg, and cheese with a vinegar slaw) and my girlfriend got the kale, gouda, and egg with pork sausage. While  the bill for the two sandwiches came out to around $20 in total, it was well worth it. Her sandwich was  a perfect savory blend with the melted gouda really adding so much flavor. My sandwich was very refreshing and delicious - we downed them both so quickly!


Many people came for bagels to go, and service is relatively fast (we waited maybe 10 min because ours were hot sandwiches - most people waited just a few for bagels with spreads). They also serve a variety of drinks  and other sandwiches, but I would definitely come back to have more of the bagel sandwiches next time I'm in the area!

Hamilton infuses fresh ingredients into every dish, compliments of the restaurant's garden which provides various herbs and veggies that pack some phenomenal flavor notes. There's nothing quite like a bourbon smash made with fresh mint at Hamiltons!
I'm a big fan of their steaks, which are well-seasoned and cooked just right. They have options at various price points and some non-beef menu items if that's your jam.
The interior is just gorgeous - you need to come in to really feel the awesome vibes that this place is adding to the foodie scene in the Lou!

This was our first experience at Rick's Reef and we enjoyed the food. We ordered the jumbo fried shrimp dinner with fries and potato salad as sides $14.50 & we ordered the blackened grouper dinner with fried corn on the cob and garlic mashed potatoes $16 . The shrimp were a good size and tasty. The fries were fresh natural cut, not crisp but tasty. The potato salad was chunky and lightly tasty. The serving was a bit too large for the light taste. I probably should have asked for a little mustard or bbq sauce to add to it. The blackened grouper was flavorful and not too spicy. The garlic mashed potatoes were very tasty. The fried corn wasn't what we were expecting as it wasn't battered and fried, just fried. Service was good. They offer indoor and outdoor seating and we chose outdoor being close to the water. Big mistake as there are plenty of smokers. Our server wore her mask as did we. None of the other guests even had a mask and the server for the table beside us didn't wear one either. People came in after us and sat at the table right beside us rather than skipping a table . This along with the no mask was quite disconcerting and very uncomfortable. 
The food is very good and we recommend. This is a very casual bar restaurant.

Best burgers and fries. Brady our server was maybe the best server in my life. Decor is fun and interesting. We were able to watch the Titans game. Another plus. 
Do yourself a favor and come here. You will be glad you did.
I love this shop. Great food. Great customer service . Nice and peaceful inside. Even great coffee.

I'll start this review by saying I am not a big sandwich guy - something about bread overpowering what's between the bread just makes no sense to me. If you've found yourself on this page, chances are you definitely disagree with me. Nonetheless, I might not be a big sandwich guy, but Middle Child makes me want to be.

Ordered pickup on their website midweek around lunchtime. Went with a Court Street's Reuben on a hoagie and a Baller Classic on a hoagie. The wait wasn't too long, and their website time estimate was on point for pickup which was really helpful for planning my arrival. One suggestion - plan ahead when you order - this is a VERY popular and busy shop that has been kicking butt during covid! Even if the wait time is longer than you expected - it is worth every second. I knew that I wanted my food in 45 mins to an hour, so I ordered accordingly. There have also been days where they temporarily turn off online ordering because they're swamped - check back on their website periodically or check their Instagram story for updates! A little planning goes a long way!!

Now for the food - the reuben was without a doubt the best reuben I've ever had - the short rib corned beef was INSANE, and the kraut, sauce, and cheese were perfect. The Baller was also great - something about the combo of mayo, pickles, and red onions made it extra special.

Super excited I was finally able to get takeout from MC and will definitely do so again soon. Next time, I'm looking forward to th
Salmon was super, and the prep was nice. But the tuna and other fish were just so-so. Maybe expectations of good sushi are impossible during the lockdown. Will try again in a few months.

Incredible food, great service and conveniently located right next to public access to the beach. I ordered the breakfast burrito with potatoes for myself, which was incredible. My boyfriend ordered the French toast and I'd be lying if I said it wasn't the absolute best French toast I've ever tasted in my life. Will definitely be back when I return to Clearwater!

I have given this restaurant many chances. I place to go orders online and consistently when coming to pick it up they haven't even looked at the order to start making it. The employees and managers don't seem to care at all. So aggravating. Not coming back, which is sad becuase the food is good.

Costera is everything I want a restaurant to be. Honestly I think it's underrated. It is literally shocking to me that this isn't constantly voted as one of the top restaurants in the city. My husband and I eat here as often as we can. We have had just about every menu item and often order the specials. The food is just ridiculously good. The service is top notch. The atmosphere is great. The drinks are delicious.

This is one my favorite restaurants in Idaho. The food is incredible and I love the owners. Everyone who works here is so nice. I got the Spaghetti Alla Carbonara and the Penne Alla Vodka. They were both amazing. The Fritto Misto was also incredible. Everything is fresh and makes you feel like you're in Italy. Vincenzo and his wife are welcoming and such hard workers. I literally crave their food. It's that good. I definitely recommend this restaurant. It has real authentic Italian food.

Grungy inside, food was barely edible. They got our order wrong, and assumed we wanted hash browns instead of home fries. Our bill was incorrect and the onion rings left a gross after taste. Keep on driving and don't stop for this dive.

I do like this place (which I found on yelp, of course...), but I was not anticipating it to be one of these deli/order at the counter/-type of places . FYI everything is pre-made in a cooler, and you do order at the counter, then sit down and wait for it. I was anticipating something different - was in the mood for more of a sit down/breakfast/lunch - but that is not what it is. Mind you, for what it is, this place is very nice and upscale, and the food is indeed good - it just all depends on what kind of atmosphere you are seeking.

Outside seating during COVID.
Great service and the Staff was excellent and very kind. 
Crab Cake benedict & pancake combo were ordered.  Large portions were served.
Will definitely come back when passing through.
Overall ok but checking out it took 40 minutes or more for them to bring out our luggage because they had lost it. The cost of it for me and the husband was not worth it.

Originally I reviewed this incorrectly. I confused this place with another eatery in the same area. I ate here for the first time two days ago. MSBC has somewhat a limited menu. It's selection is biscuit based. I ate their special, the Squawking Goat biscuit. I also tried their fried green tomatoes. Both were good. I will return and try their waffle dish. There were many people inside and outside, so I'm guessing it's popular. They seem to have their own coffee and maybe it's popular for coffee drinkers. Next time I'll try it. This location is only open until 2pm. I'll go during breakfast hours next time.

This is cafeteria pizza at best. Pass. Garlic knots lacked joie de vive, pizza was greasy, cheese low-quality. I was the only customer being served and my order was wrong so had to wait another 30 min for it to be corrected. Was not worth the wait.

Love it here! Probably spent $200 between the last weekend and now . So insane how when we asked our awesome waitress to cash us out (so she can get a tip) and to ask someone else to come help us! Had to have my partner go to the bar for help (after 10-15 mins) then they send a new waitress accompanied by a man as if it required all that. We were polite, ordered new drinks. Then this lady told us her shift was ending we asked to transfer our checks. (Hadnt't we gone through enough?) 

Oh my gosh it was fun watching the other waitress debate with our current if she would take our table lmao. Then after a 15 minute debate she comes asking if we need anything. Umm no maybe next time where I can't see you having a convo how you DONT wanna help us  man you should've seen how quick she brought our check though! 

I was outraged with my partner trying to tip this girl ANYTHING. She was so rude not wanting to help! Tip her for what? Bringing our bill? How dare he! For bringing our bill?? Bye.  I wanted to chase the previous waitress so I could tip her instead. 

I was a previous server and have a lot of patience. Clearly we went to reforma where we always have good service. Funny cause my Intuition said go to reforma. It's so weird how they're owned by the same person/ group (rumored haven't verified, but they always have better service.). I would blame it on volume but they had what, 12 tables between 4 people?

I have been here twice and the first time was amazing we came on a Sunday evening and it was not busy at all. I thought it would be busy because it's newer and this type of food is becoming popular. The second time we came the taste was amazing still but just a little too greasy.

Sorry to post a mediocre review bc the staff was nice, but the food was just okay. I was so excited for the vegetarian/soy chicken- it was just slices of a tofu log with sauce on it. I was hoping for orange chicken (like a deep fried piece of chicken in the sauce), but tofu instead. 

They also did not give us silverware or napkins, which is really annoying when you order take out. We are staying in a hotel and had to ask the front desk for utensils- glad they had them. 

Overall not very good. Disappointed because it seemed like the owners have been in business 35+ years and was just hoping for better.
The best pizza in BROWNSBURG. They also have great salads and deliver. Their food is our normal Friday night or Football Sunday menu. The prices are right.

Thought we'd stop by and try this new Joella's hot chicken spot. Only problem was this place was slammed busy, so we opted to go through the drive-thru.

So the options here are, chicken tenders, wings, quarter or half chicken. They also have chicken and waffles, chicken sandwich's that boast chicken salad, chicken sandwich with homemade pimento cheese, chicken sandwich with sweet vinegar slaw and garlic aïoli, or a classic chicken sandwich with pickles. They have a couple of salads.

So it says easy as 1-2-3. #1, pick your choice of chicken with your pick of "heat" six choices of heat. #2 choose your dipping sauce. There are eight choices ranging from blue cheese honey mustard ranch and pimento Ranchero to name a few. #3 make your choice of southern sides, Such as creamy mac & cheese, crispy thin fries, potato salad, sweet vinegar slaw, collard greens, or Redskin mashed potatoes with gravy.

So we chose for our meals jumbo tenders. She with no heat, ranch dipping sauce, and crispy thin fries. My jumbo tenders meal I ordered medium hot, blue cheese dipping sauce, crispy thin fries, and collard greens. A big problem with our meals were that they were not hot by the time we got home ( a very short ride). I noticed other reviews had the same problem. The thin fries cooled off way too fast, the chicken couldn't have been hot when they placed it in the Styrofoam box. Collard greens were pretty good. The chicken was just OK.

We'll try them again once the newness wears off.

This place is open during covid and employees are not all wearing masks. I told one of them that it only works if it's pulled up from her chin to cover her nose and mouth and she rolled her eyes and said "ok thank" and proceeded to leave it down by her chin. Do better, Chipotle.

On past trips to Ming Kitchen I would say that it is average Chinese food at best, but decided to give them another shot last night. I placed my order and was told that it would be a twenty minute wait... that turned into about a fifty minute wait. When I got home and opened the food, I noticed a scorched smell from the lo mien and when putting it on a plate I noticed a staple in the bottom of the container with the noodles. The fried rice also had the same scorched smell and taste. Both containers of the General Tso chicken tasted old and stringy. Upset stomach was endured by all in the house who nibbled at the food from there last night. 
There are many other Restaurants in town and it will be highly unlikely that I will order again from this place!

This place is amazing!  The soft serve is creamy and tasty.  You can build a sundae by adding cake and toppings.  You cannot go wrong by stopping here.  The place is clean and the staff members are nice.

One of the best sushi spots in Lakeview has to be Lotus Bistro! The weather was beautiful, and I loved their outdoor dining options. They also have curbside pickup!

I started with the Crab Ragoons, and they were so crispy! I loved the sauce and the amount of snow crab inside. I then ordered the Lotus Roll which was a really good no-rice option! The sauce on top tasted like a garlic sauce which was delicious. 

I finished with the PB&J Roll which was a dessert roll made of peanut butter, fried, and topped with vanilla ice cream and fresh strawberries! It was literally spectacular, and I would recommend sharing this roll because it's very filling. 

The staff was so kind and attentive; I will definitely be back soon!
Bought some Cuban goodies today and they looked so fresh and flaky!  I wish they had a bakery like this closer.  Yum

I usually can't stand fast food but Culvers food is way beyond better than any other fast food restaurant I have been to. The staff is nice.  They seem to be very organized because my order is always right and it never takes a long time. The butter burgers with cheese is really good. The chicken fingers are really good. The chicken fingers are a heck of a lot better than that bland garbage at Canes. I hate crinkle fries so much but here they actually taste really good. The fries are still crunchy even  after a 10 minute drive home. I never need to add salt to any of the food. The biggest highlight is the ice cream concrete mixers. They are the best. It's my new standard for ice cream and nothing gets close to how good their ice cream is.

The teriyaki chicken is my favorite. My order is always correct and hot! I could also live off of their egg drop soup! The best deals are their lunch deals! Its filling and I always have more left over for the next day.

We went for our anniversary there and only tried their sushi and their Asian flavoured wings, I can't say the rolls were bad but they weren't good. The rolls were pretty sloppy and messy. I probably wouldn't go back for sushi, heard good things  about their main dishes though, so I might go back to try those!

I visited pre-COVID and had a pretty good experience. There were no reservations so I had to wait for about an hour in the sun room area. My wife and I ended up being seated at the bar, which was less than ideal, but we really couldn't wait any longer. 

We got the roasted vegetable Caesar salad to start and the cheese pizza with pepperoni. The vegetable salad really wasn't good, the vegetables were mushy, and the dressing didn't have much flavor. I would skip that all together and stick to the pies. The pizza came out quickly, and was pretty good, but I can't say it was worth the hype, wait, and Uber ride. If you're in the area and it's a slow day, pop on in. I wouldn't go out of my way to visit though. I didn't try the soft serve and needless to say I won't be returning for just that.

Roasted vegetable Caesar 1/5
Pepperoni Pizza 4/5
The food was good but the waitress was rude. They also didn't bring us water when we asked and acted aggravated when we reminded them.

This was the best experience i have ever had in my life in a restaurant. The food was delicious and the service was incredible! The waiter literally sat and explained the menu and did his very best to make my cousin and i feel comfortable. None of the restaurants in the area had any more reservations for the night. I went on OpenTable and got a reservation in no time! The restaurant was clean, and the restaurant was doing an amazing job at social distancing. I will definitely be coming back!

Meh... I was here on a Monday evening to grab food.  Say at the bar, because the rest of the place was crazy (Game Night) The bartender was good and friendly. It took an hour to get 2 sliders, fries, and an order of shrimp. The sliders were cold and missing items. I had to take it to go by the time they corrected it. I was impressed with the garlic parm fries tho, so today I ordered wings and the those fries thru Grubhub. The chicken wasn't cooked enough, and it didn't have any flavor (Honey Garlic). It seemed to be a mild buffalo sauce instead, forgot the blue cheese on the side (Irritating). Going back to Monday, I feel like if the kitchen can't handle the crowd and large amount of orders, maybe hosting a game night isn't a good idea. As far as today's experience, I'll never order delivery again. This is the type of place where you need to be there to make sure your order is cooked properly and it's correct. This place is very mediocre, masked by its prime location. Management obviously couldn't give a rat's a$$ about the ratings, inconsistency, or lack of attention to food. A 2.5 average rating is nothing to be proud of.

My usual disdain for corporate restaurants in the city of Philadelphia is strong. But I must say that even in my resistance this place *sort of* makes sense. Full disclosure: I grew up about 20 minutes from St. Louis Missouri and then ended up living in the city of St. Louis for the last four years before I moved to Philadelphia (in 1993). The St. Louis Bread Company opened its doors in Kirkwood Missouri in the late 80's. Somehow I discovered this place and would make frequent trips because I hadn't tasted a sandwich that good. Somewhere along the line Panera Bread acquired the stores and I guess they have over 2,000 stores in the United States. They specialize in sandwiches and soups, coffee and wifi. 
When I realized that Panera was coming to the space at 40th and Walnut it made me feel sad. Why? Why can't something innovative and charming move in? I have seen this space in many forms and it always goes the way of closing. The latest rendition was Harvest Seasonal Grill which seemed way too cooperate for this West Philly neighborhood. And now Panera.
I had a great salad there today along with a veggie sandwich and both were good. The space is huge and clean and the upstairs offers tons of seating and in the winter will provide fire pits. I sat outside with my good friend and had good fare in a spacious, clean space and told her the humble start of St. Louis Bread Co.
I am not fond of the chain store. But nothing has worked here and I get the logic of serving up predictable

I'm truly disappointed by this place. If I could I wouldn't even leave one star. When I arrived the lady was very rude and took her sweet time to get to me even though I placed an order for pick up and she saw me. I stayed nice and respectful but I knew I was not going to leave a tip. Anyways, I ordered beef with lemon grass and a side of shrimp spring rolls and they were both terrible. The traditional dish was cold, the meat had no flavor, the noodles were hard, and overall not tasty or satisfying. The spring rolls were poorly wrapped and the wrapping itself was hard. The shrimp was soggy and had a terrible fishy smell to it. This business does not need to be in business. Will never go here again and I do NOT recommend.

Really good place; well prepared and flavored pasta. Wife had the seafood linguini which she really enjoyed and I had a special fusilli with tomato cream sauce with sausage, mushrooms, onions, chili flakes and fennel seeds. Absolutely delicious. Portions are also incredibly generous for the price. If it were lunch time, we easily could have shared the fusilli. Definitely recommend stopping here if you're passing by Carpinteria.

Higher end like the scallops left some much to be desired for the price. Kids meals are frozen box items and less than appetizing and greasy. Was truly disappointing as restaurant is always busy. Won't be returning.

Hadn't been to Judge Bean's in a while. Probably due to location, it's bit off the main road so you are unlikely to just drive by. It's basically a BBQ type place, lots of rough wood decor, not too brightly lit, smells of smoky meats. 
They have a good selection of beers including beers on draft. I went with Black Abbey's the Rose, which was on the rotating selection list.  
Our server was pleasant and beers came promptly. 
I ordered a pulled pork BBQ sandwich with the side of sweet potato fries. The Sandwich was good, great meat flavor, I added some BBQ sauce that was on the table and topped with the small side of cole slaw they included. That's just the way I like it, only improvement could have been a pickle, but hey, it was fine!  Sweet potato fries were really not up to par, they are waffle type fries and about half were seriously over cooked, some to the point of being almost black. As we were on the very early side of dinner and it wasn't terribly crowded, I'm not sure to what you can attribute that? I have to wonder if folks plating realized it since the overdone ones were tucked under the better ones when the dish was plated?
A rat ran over my foot while eating, went to the table next to us and then back to my feet lol

I cannot believe I haven't reviewed this place yet. It is my go-to lunch spot and I just cannot get enough. 

Located inside the Indianapolis City Market (in my opinion the spot you can go when you know what food you want or when you don't). Back to Duos, I frequent the Balance Bowl with the addition of tofu. The perfect combination of warm (rice, beans and tofu) and the coolness of spinach, peppers, the light sauce makes the perfect combination. Typically this bowl features egg, but you can remove it if you're getting the vegan option. They have two verisons of the sauce, so if you're ordering a totally vegan bowl make sure you ask them 

Even if you're not a fan of tofu, I highly suggest trying it at least once because they are cooking it to perfection. 

Cannot rave about this place enough. Plus: their customer service is out of this world.

This place is well worth a visit. Not expensive but you get want you want. We ordered stir fried Mei Fan, French toast, popcorn chicken, a Guangxi style rice noodle, and a congee. All dishes are pretty authentic.

We ate here three nights in a row on our last trip to NOLA and could not get enough of it. The spicy Bloody Mary is on point and the oysters are to die for! We lived the bartending staff and the chargrilled oyster chef. We will definitely be back very soon.
Great Mexican food!  Have enjoyed takeout and dining in on the weekend.  Service excellent.

The best part of our dining experience was how quickly our food arrived. Seriously it only took 10 minutes and it was way faster than getting our drinks, menus, extra salsa check, to go boxes- you name it. There were times we didn't see our waitress for long stretches.
We sat outside on a Thursday evening, it was busy, but there were several open tables. The service was super slow other than food delivery. The management needs to look at increasing staffing and improving efficiency .

I was surprised by the mixed reviews. Just ordered two lunch specials. We had the nine-piece sashimi with a spicy tuna roll and the two roll special with salmon avocado and a shrimp tempura roll. Both came with a side salad and miso soup. Lots of food for about $25. Can't beat that price for good sushi. The sashimi was incredibly fresh. Their salmon was buttery and melt in your mouth. I will definitely be back!

I wish I could give this place zero stars. The short guy working the door on 01/29 night teased me like I was a dog waiting for a treat. He let me think I was waiting in line to get in when in reality he was never letting me in because I, "didn't know someone inside."
Come for the deals. Stay for the sushi. This place has the best deals so far in philly for some decent sushi.

Food is amazing but our service was severely lacking. 
The gnocchi is amazing, the pork belly is to die for and the prime rib was perfectly done. 
It however, took us a couple of hours to get all of it. All of our food came out at random times without reason or explanation as to why. I wonder if it is supposed to be more of a shared tapas environment, we ordered it as individuals. We saw our server maybe 4 times so I am sure it was a lack of communication. If we had known things were timed like that we would have ordered much differently. Our entire table of 9 had eaten and cleared out before the prime rib showed up and our server was annoyed when we found him to ask about it. Also be aware there is automatically 20% tip added (for groups?) that didn't show up with the original receipt but did on the breakdown on the second receipt, so pay attention.

Small family owned and operated restaurant but worth finding. The food is very authentic and fairly priced. The customer service is good and the food is plentiful. One thing I like is the salsa bar, it has several options plus cilantro, onions, limes, etc. You order at the counter and then find a seat, there is limited availability. They will bring your drinks and a bowl of homemade chips for you to enjoy while waiting for your meal. The best thing I have found is that they have Mexican Pepsi, the real Pepsi. Most restaurants have Mexican Coke not Pepsi. If there is any negative it is that the restaurant is small and can get very busy during peak lunch hours, so plan accordingly because it's worth it.
Great sushi! I had the golden dragon and the black dragon roll and they were both excellent. I got delivery because of COVID. I ended up eating there once before COVID and the service was fantastic!

We stopped here on a whim because the place we had planned on going was closed for New Year's Day. This was actually our favorite meal while in New Orleans. Small menu, but everything sounded really good, and our two meals (shrimp and grits with biscuit and bacon basil grilled cheese) were phenomenal. Cool little space that felt very local. Really glad we stopped here.

Yep, yet another 5-star review here. Expect nothing less than a 5-star melt of flavor in any dish you get here. Today was my second day in a row stopping in and this may just be my newest addiction. I can see this place becoming the best "problem" I could inherit. 

Now, I'm no vegan, certainly an omnivore but I am curbing my consumption of meats and this place makes it an effortless transition. They offer different amounts you can put on a plate, from 1-5 items. I believe they have non-cafeteria style options but I'm usually in a hurry so I've gotten whatever they have out. The (main) options seem to change up each day but be brave and get whatever they have, you won't be let down. 

Yesterday I got a main of sautéed veggies, Mac n cheese and their hot n sweet fried cauliflower. Today I got the lasagna, Mac n cheese and curry veggies with a lil side of their bread pudding. I'll tell ya like this, if folks can make vegan dishes taste like this, I won't be missing meat at all. This food is seriously good, y'all. 

I'll be seeing ya tomorrow.

Absolutely horrible, food was fine, but service was worst I've ever had. Seated at 6 and got our food at 7:30. Server messed up multiple orders at our table, I heard the guy who seated us, telling his MANAGER, he is done hearing what people have to say, (because customers were complaining) to him. Absolute circus of a staff, I could run a better restaurant out of my garage.

While visiting here for the first time we have tried many restaurants and I have to say we found our favorite one the food was absolutely amazing and so was the service our waitress Mary made us feel at home and took great care of us will definitely be back highly recommend
Ate here for the first time this morning.  Food was outstanding and staff were very accommodating and friendly.  Love supporting local businesses like this.  Keep up the awesome job.

This place is awesome! I recently went vegan and this has been one of the few meals that I just loved. It doesn't sacrifice taste, substance, or value. I was only in Tampa for 3days but I had to at least stop by one more time. There is a dish in the veggie section of the menu and it has some lentil, potato, and spinach. This dish is great. There is also a bread similar to naan but with no butter and it's wheat. Best Indian food I've had ever. Also, very friendly staff, clean, and great for families.

Fast, friendly service here! I ordered the double protein bowl with steak  and chicken. Some bowls come in 2 sizes, but this one is just the regular size. Kind of pricey ($12.66) for the small portion I got. The steak was surprisingly good, but the chicken was dry. Since it's a protein bowl, you don't get chips :(.

I LOVE que, I swear I could eat it 3 times a day,, this place is no slouch ive been there maybe 6 times since I discovered it a year ago (dont judge) 

The only negative thing I have to say is that they seem to always be out of grits and Greens whenever I'm there . 

But the food and service at this place are outstanding and I can be a harsh critic of food establishments 

Give it a try you wont be disappointed

I've stopped by here every time Ive visited Reno. Best service I've ever received out all restaurant I've been to. From the bartenders to management, some of the most welcoming and warming people. Couldn't think of a better go to spot!

I had dinner here tonight - it was delicious. The portions were just right and I have leftovers for lunch. Spice level was perfect for medium and our service was great. Highly recommend and I will definitely be back!

Absolutely no greeting from the staff. I was told we couldn't be seated due to they were between shifts. As we sat there for about 10 minutes I watched a gentleman load meat into the freezer/fridge without gloves after that we quickly got up and left.

Cozy cafe with great ambiance, fun music and delicious food. Breakfast staples with a farm to table and creative twist. Staff was friendly and accommodating. Heads up! Cash only but they have an ATM on site.

We went as a group of 6 and were able to try just about everything on the menu family style. Every single item was delicious and amazing. My favorite was the focaccia. It is a very small restaurant though with very limited seating. And hidden since there no name to be found outside. But well worth it IMO.

Delicious pizza and fun spot! I love the pretzel bites as an appetizer! The pizza and calzones are good. My only drawback is the dough is kind of yeasty so that's not my fave part but it's still really good.

The decor and vibe is 100% on point. The patio is also so cool and one of the best parts of the restaurant.

Check it out and enjoy being mellow
Great little market with fresh meats. Homemade cheeses and marinara as well as prepared salads and subs. Weekly specials make it worth it.

This is a really nice place to come have breakfast or brunch. It is located off west 86th street in the same plaza as krogers. There is plenty of parking due to the amount of stores in this plaza. A few of my friends and I came here on a Saturday morning. It was a decent amount of people inside already, but we only waited about 10 or 12 minutes before a table was ready. The host was really nice and directed us to our table in the back. A waitress then came up to hand us menus and tell us what the specials were. She pointed to the board behind us on a wall and it listed all the drink options. We all told her we wanted the mimosa flight and she laughed. I'm pretty sure she was use to people choosing them. I originally found this restaurant on Instagram and I seen the many videos advertising the mimosa flight. You get a choice of 4 mini mimosas. They have a list of the available flavors on the wall. I don't remember all four flavors I picked, but the pina colada and grapefruit mimosas was my favorites. One of my friends actually picked two pina colada's for her flight. She loves a good pina colada lol. For breakfast I picked the red velvet waffles with potatoes and turkey sausage patties. I was excited to see turkey sausage as an option. I do not eat pork and it's very rare for breakfast places to have turkey or chicken bacon or sausage. The food came out hot and even the syrup was warm. That was a plus plus for me. Above all the food was good. The restaurant is nice and clean.

Love this place! The drinks and atmosphere are top notch. The bartender is really friendly provided great conversation. The whisky collection is very good for Reno providing a great selection for whisky aficionados. To top it off, the old fashioned cocktail has bacon in it! Highly recommended.
First time visit to O'Maddy's. Great view, good music and awesome crab cake. Leah A was our server. She was wonderful!  We will be back!

Awesome piece for a great price! Grabbed some lunch here recently and even though it's to go orders only it was easily one the most flavorful pizzas I've ever had. Highly recommend any pizza lover to try this place!

We discovered the Brewhouse when we were tourists in Santa Barbara and now that we live here it is our go-to spot for a good meal with outdoor seating where we can bring our dogs.  First, they have a dog menu and our dogs expect their steak-bits before we get our orders.  Second, we've tried any number of things on the menu (salads, fish and chips, burgers, enchiladas, sandwiches) and they are all really good. We expected good beer, since it is a brewhouse, but have been continually wowed by the quality of the good.   We always sit outside which is not noisy, except for the occasional train going by (it's near the station).  The service is almost always excellent.

Very bad service, been coming here for years believe they might be under new management. Presentation of food was horrible, also had to wait 30 mins for  just drinks and chips when it was very empty inside.

I'm so over business's that don't update their hours. I checked google, their website and yelp. They all confirmed the hours. Sure enough get here and closed. I understand there's a virus but it takes 1 min to update hours that will save a customer from an hour of wasted drive time.

From the moment we walked in, we were greeted promptly, everyone was so friendly. Our waiter was amazing, answered all of our questions and was very helpful. Will definitely be going back , especially for the crab cakes!

Zeppoli is an adorable, cozy Italian restaurant located in Collingswood. They are currently offering indoor dining (at decreased capacity) and outdoor seating. The restaurant offers a very intimate ambience good for dates and small groups. Currently, they are offering a 3-course and a 4-course pre fixe menu. I appreciated that they were flexible allowing me to order 3 courses while my boyfriend ordered 4. If you do the 3 course option, you select one appetizer, one pasta, and one dessert. For the 4 course option, you also get an entree. 

Every dish was delicious, it's hard to pick which were the best. They also had several "extras" including a tortellini at the beginning that was *chefs kiss*. For the apps, we shared the antipasti (for two) which was some of the best I've ever had! Great selection of veggies, meats, and cheeses that were perfectly seasoned. For the pasta, I really enjoyed the gnocchi alla' argentiera which was comprised of large, delicious cheesy balls of heaven. I also liked the pesto trapanese which had the most interesting almond pesto over perfectly cooked fusilli. Lastly, for a sweet end, I also quite liked the zeppoli siciliano which were sugar-coated fluffy donuts in chocolate sauce. 

A special shoutout to our waitress *Jess* as well who was very attentive, engaging, and had great recommendations for our dinner. Overall, I had a wonderful experience at Zeppoli and enjoyed the meal, the company, and the ambience.
The food was amazing and the service was great. We went for lunch and I got the spring rolls and the chicken salad.

This was my first time here despite living in Havertown my whole life.  This was an exceptional meal with my daughter and her husband.  Steve made it all the more special
With his excellent description of the dishes.  My Branzino was superb.  Thank you for a most enjoyable meal with an attentive server.  I will certainly be back.  It was out of this world!!  Thank you!!  What a gem!!!

Absolutely terrible pizza and terrible people.. I was ok with the cheese one at first but the sausage one had like zero sausage on it I called and asked about it and was told they would give me a $5 credit for my $30.77 order and they were extremely rude and just said that's just how we make it. I then found a hair in my pizza and went back up there and the guy had a smirk on his face after me and my children ate a few bites out of the pizza before noticing.. he then slammed $30 on the counter and walked off so he didn't even give me my full amount back which is just some change which is no big deal it's just the principle my husband then told him how he is not a very nice guy as we were leaving he then shot us the bird while we were driving away. Avoid this place completely trust me! The one picture of him is when he quickly put his middle finger down when he seen me go to take a picture.
Pasta's with meat sauce very good, and prices reasonable. Staff very polite. Atmosphere is ZERO. Small tables. Old building that needs to be badly updated.

I really like this place, and I would give five stars if it were not for the gluten free mac and cheese being greasy. I this is such a nice and cosy place with organic chicken and tofu vegan options. Great food, great for a quick casual lunch with friends.
Pizzas are awesome!!!!  My husband and I love the gargantuan and save the leftovers. They reheat fantastically well.

Trendy homemade vibe to the food, although I wish the flavors were a bit stronger. Excellent service. The lady there noticed my friend and I eating outside in the snowy cold and brought over some complimentary tea for our cold hands :)

It is about 4.5 stars. Not yet truly 5 stars. It is one of the best BBQ in Bay Area. This food truck hold it place of many BBQ I had. It has very interesting side order. The selection is very special. 

The order I got is a three meats combo. This dinner come with sides. The two we have is the blue crab yellow rice with shrimp and collard green. Other side that in menu choices are truffles Mac n Cheese, Yukon potatoes, baked bean, smoked candies yum, dirty yellow rice. All the choices is great selection. The three meats are the smoke rib, pull pork, and corn beef brisket. The corn beef brisket is moist and tender. 

The food truck is popular, many customers. It is popular place for the local.

Eat well and support your local restaurants! 
$18 purchases a generous portion of meat sauce lasagna, a good sized salad, and excellent bread. This would easily make a solid dinner for two adults. Good food, good portions, fair pricing.

Amazing food. Amazing atmosphere. Worth the drive to get out to this whitestown brewery. All of the food I believe is sourced from local farms. It's is delicious. You can also catch bands performing on the weekend in the private area, which used to be a basketball court which gives it a cool vibe.

The food was AMAZING and the service from Beau was TOP KNOTCH.
The drinks were strong, but not overpowering. You could taste each ingredient. (Frozen Italian Strawberry Ice, and Noble Manhattan- 2 of these and you won't be driving haha)
The food was extremely tasteful. We started with fried calamari, and the meatballs. 
For entrees, we had the farro bowl with shrimp (I didn't know healthy eating was this good), ragotini plus short rib, and a bistro steak (medium rare). I'm drooling just typing this. Extremely generous with the servings. We couldn't finish the meals. Perfect for lunch tomorrow. I can't wait to go back!

Trishna, the new bartender, made a killer cucumber cooler, even though it's not on the menu.  The staff here was super friendly and they were so helpful in explaining the paleo concept.  I had the Salmon with goat cheese and pistachio. Loved it. Perfect healthy portion.  The primal pizza was delicious and you have the option to have it gluten free.  We will definitely come back next time we're in town.

I forgot how cute the atmosphere of this quaint little restaurant is! The food is delicious. Sit down service and takeout are both available. Don't forget your mask for sit down service. Highly suggest for your sushi cravings!

First time here.  Heard about it from some folks in Newtown, PA.  Off the beaten path from the touristy sections of Lambertville.  We ate at the bar.  Good service.   Very friendly and welcoming  patrons next to us.  We had the fried oysters and the fillet mignon sandwich for our entries.  Both were good.  Did the Brussel sprout and buratta app.  It was okay.  Preferred grilled brussels. Enjoyed our time here- nice "local" atmosphere.

Ordered 3 large Pizzas & salad for a meeting at work today.  
All 3 NY style Pizzas were devoured, Great Pizzas & Salad!  
Timely delivery too.  Everyone was happy!  Will order again.
Stop using Uber eats. The service is horrendous and the food is just not trustworthy to eat after it takes an hour to deliver nearly anywhere.
This place has such amazing local art on the inside!! I am blown away by the amount of small businesses in Asheville who support their artists! Great Vietnamese coffee too.
Ordered the mandi dumplings and Ali nazik for delivery.   100% worth it. Although both have red chili oil, it's not spicy, for others who can't take spice as well.

I'll begin by saying that I don't typically leave reviews on Yelp/google/etc, but after the experience I had at the Lucky Dog, I felt I had to. My now wife and I ended up holding our rehearsal dinner in the event space on the second floor. The space feels very quaint (fireplace, exposed brick) and had a private bathroom upstairs. We had ~60 people and had more than enough room for a cocktail hour and dinner. We worked directly with the owner (Barrie) on the event, and she was tremendously helpful picking out decorations, menu choices, etc. while working within our budget. On the day of the event, the staff was flexible when we were running late, and they accomodated a few guests that dietary restrictions. I wouldn't have thought this place has Impossible meatballs (think BK Impossible Whopper)! The food we selected was great, and they even packaged the leftovers for us. The event space is definitely a hidden gem in Conshy!

I have always had a great experience for lunch, dinner or drinks with friends but tonight was awful. A group of friends were at the bar and we are told we have to leave as the bar area has been reserved for a private party. There were no signs posted saying "Bar area closed 7-9 for private party ". They were telling customers in the bar area they had to close out and clear the area. The owner was there and said nothing to any of us. One of the guests from the party was actually telling patrons who were waiting for a tables in the restaurant who wanted a drink that they could not go to the bar. Very very poor management. I will not be recommending this restaurant to anyone.

I ordered a pizza from them Wednesday during this pandemic because I wanted to support them during this tough time. The order I received on Wednesday was perfect. Service was prompt. I left a nice tip and decided to order from there again tonight.

 After ordering and seeing that it was in the works, Sabria then calls me 15 mins later to say they had closed. I was confused because they had 45 minutes left before closing. I asked why she waited 15 mins before calling me. She lied and said I did call. I'm like ok, no you didn't... it's obvious I'm not getting the food because you are stuttering and making up excuses, I am in the right and the order should have been made. I asked to speak to a manager and she said she was. I said ok so how can we make this right? I manage for a center city restaurant and that's the first thing you do as management. She said "I'm just telling you we not makin ya food" and then hung up on me!  A "MANAGER" HUNG UP ON A PAYING CUSTOMER DURING A PANDEMIC!! When you need all the business you can get!!! 

Her name is Sabria and if she is the manager (doubt it), she really needs a wake-up call. Not to mention she had another younger employee answer and transfer words back and forth when I called back to speak to a manager. All of this for a small pizza. Sabria was soooo disrespectful, yelling in the background, telling the younger employee what to say to me, while I never, ever even raised my voice. I will speak to the owner/real manager tomorrow. Custo

Amazing as always! Hands down the best bagel I've had probably ever. My go to is the #4 on tomato pesto, plus it's vegetarian. I learned today also that the pesto is nut free which is a win for my boyfriend who is allergic to nuts. The staff is always very nice and helpful. With COVID they have made changes to their operation. You order from a window outside and pickup at the next window, no indoor seating but there are a few outdoor tables. My only gripe is that there is no gluten free bagel option (yet). Despite this, I'll still come here every time I need a delicious breakfast.

It has a nice decor, the waitress was knowledgeable of the menu and very attentive. The Menu was small and to the point. My wife ordered a pasta dish and I ordered a pizza, the pasta dish was not aldente and a deal breaker for me, the pizza was not up to my liking but I guess for people that have never had great pizza, it would be the best. Overall the place is nice , the waitress/waiter were very attentive and the food was OK.
Horrible service tonight! Deja was our server and never checked on us. The food was cold!! Needs new management & servers!!

I ordered desserts to-go and was extremely disappointed in what I received. The "fried" ice cream was just a scoop of ice cream with a handful of corn flakes on top. Either they forgot the frying or are just too lazy. I also ordered sopapillas and received what seems to be tortillas chips covered in honey and cinnamon. Don't come here for desserts.

We were there on Sunday mid day. New atrium is beautiful. We were appropriately spaced in seating. Food was horrible. We are it only because we were so hungry. Never will we go there again. The menu advertised a Meat Lovers Breakfast. I hope you don't like meat!! You needed  a microscope to find the meat among the few chopped potatoes. Small serving as well. The toast was warm sliced bread with butter, not toasted. Server never asked to refill coffee. She is very obviously a new server. The breakfast specials are not cheap, which is okay if your food is tasty and inclusive of the menu description. 
Never again to this diner.

The lupa lupa is a nice 2 person drink - really tasty and will make you smile :) - nice bar , relaxed , in one place with the hotel - tikki themed - bartender was nice guy , nice stories and well knowledged on his drinks

Returned on the 2nd day - and have to revise - one of the best places I had cocktails , today pearl diver , and Paul in the jungle - finest drinks

I came here for the first time and all I can say is I'm very happy with the food, service, and environment. Gabe was an amazing bartender and was on top of anything I needed ! And the food was amazing and came out hot and quick. Delicious place and wonderful staff. Will definitely be back !

I've gotta go with an upgrade here; Middle Child makes some bomb ass sandwiches! I've been back several times since my first visit to try the Shopsin Club. It's hard to deviate from the breakfast sandwich, which has become a favorite. The eggs are so plentiful and buttery; the cheese is oozy perfection! 

Today, I was in the neighborhood again and decided to revisit the Shopsin Club. I do believe this sandwich was better than the last time I tried it. The roll was soft and slightly crunchy; it also did not overpower the ingredients. I ordered the miso mayo on the side since I'm weird about mayo, but I found myself dipping the sandwich repeatedly because the mayo really brought the taste to another level. The pickles were calling to me so I got a side of dill and sweet mixed together. 

I arrived slightly before noon and it was already bumpin' with a ten minute or so wait. I happened to notice that there is a small selection of grab and go sammies which is a great option if you're in a rush.

Definitely go find this hidden gem in the Eldorado, right across from Brew Brothers! 

Hidden Pizza is an awesome by-the-slice pizza place. Personally I think it's the best grab-and-go food place at The Row. 

The slices are large and the crust is thin and chewy. While I'm a fan on endless toppings on my pizza I actually really like just getting the regular pepperoni here. It's exactly what you'd imagine when you think of a good slice of pizza. Just simple and delicious!

You can definitely add toppings to any pizza if you're so inclined. They generally always have pepperoni, cheese, and meat lovers. They also have a rotating specialty pizza like Hawaiian and veggie. Both of these are also good if you're in the mood for pineapple on your pizza or a white sauce based one respectively. 

After you've chosen your pizza they'll heat it up in the firebrick oven and have it out in a few minutes. 

Now my favorite part: the shakers. They have several herbs/spices you can add like Parmesan and red pepper flakes, but I like to add the crushed garlic. So good! 

Keep in mind that they don't open until 5pm, but they are open late. A great place for a late night snack when you're enjoying a night out. The only downside is they can get a busy and if they run out of anything it does take a little while for them to make more.

New to west philly and didn't trust a lot of these Chinese restaurants BUT THIS ONE IS LEGIT. The food is super flavorful, every bite was delightful. They also have an Americanized portion of the menu for beginners. Definitely step out the box when ordering from here being everything is good I ordered a bunch of stuff being I like to pick at things and everything was so good, yummy. The spicy cold noodles was my favorite dish
Really good pizza but like most pizza joints in New Orleans crust barely has a yeast taste. But overall a good pizza, if ordered to be delivered can take a while.

If Your Thing Is Going Into A Place That's So Loud You Can't Think & The only Way To Communicate With Your Date Is To Shout Into Her Ear ... This Is Your kind Of Place But Certainly Not  Mine ... I Was There Once To Meet Friends & Hated It ... Then I Had To Be Dragged Back For A Friend's Birthday & Stayed Only 10 Minutes & Left Never To Return Again  !  This Is The Worst Restaurant I've Ever Been In ... Good Luck  With Your Ear Doctor ...The Only Thing  "That Drops" Out Is Your Hearing !

Just your run of the mill Panera Bread.  It was clean and busy but I had no issues getting served in a timely fashion.  Surprisingly they had both loaves of bread I wanted.  

Plenty of parking and it's located in a little strip mall along a main road.  Not much else to say about this location.  Panera's are really a hit or miss but this one so far has been okay.

We needed a place like this in Brownsburg. Prices are great and the food was delicious.. customer service was friendly and the restaurant was very clean. Will definetly be making this a regular meal spot!

Horrible! My son wanted to try the Travis Scott Burger. They gave him an uncooked Burger I didn't notice until I looked to see what was so special about this burger! I instantly got disgusted! The supervisor didn't wanna give me a refund! The drive thru Worked laughed like it was funny! Absolutely unacceptable

We Celebrated the Chinese New Year and Birthdays with some tasty Dumplings from a Jewel's Noodle Kitchen located at 5683 E Speedway, in the same plaza as Big 5 opposite of Autozone East of Craycroft.

The Xiao Long Bao, Beef Rolls, and potsticker-Fried Dumplings were exceptional, as were the Triple dumplings, Chicken with Carrot and Hot & Sour Soup. There are also many vegetarian options to enjoy the Vegetarian pie, dumplings and Tomato Egg Noodles, among others.
This place is disorganized, don't eat in if you go at all. The pizza is over seasoned and borderline salty. The exhaust fan must be broken too. Won't be going there again.

With the virus causing a stay-at-home situation, we've enjoyed more home delivery than usual.  The promptness of service and the variety of dining options made Slice Of The Burg an attractive option.  We haven't been disappointed. Our go-to is pizza but the calzone is huge and delicious. The onion rings should be called Casper the Ghost 'cause they keep disappearing. 
No problems with ordering, the price is reasonable and the food arrives hot and on time.
What's not to like.
Delicious! Good environment and great food. Our server in the bar did phenomenal. Wish I could get her a survey for exceptional service! Great job outback. Hostess was kind.
I've tried it twice, first time everything tasted like fish. The second time I ordered everything was extremely salty and cold.

I went to the applebees in Largo, Maryland and the service was terrible.  I ordered the grilled Chicken breast with broccoli and a loaded potatoes . First of all there was no silverware/napkin on the table when we arrived.  The waiter took quite a while to finally get to us and we finally ordered and the food came it was terrible, everything was cold, the broccoli was lukewarm and had to be sent back.  The chicken breast was as dry as the  sahara dessert, the loaded potatoes had very little cheese, bacon or anything else in it, they had to bring me another one.  I ordered the blondie for dessert and it came without the pecan's that was supposed to be on top of the dessert, the server said he could not find the pecans in the kitchen.  He finally bought the pecans after I had finished eating the dessert,  It was a bust from the beginning to the end.  the must must a little too loud and should be turned down so folks could talk while enjoying their dinner.  I have went to may applebees all over the U.S. and this is by far the worst.  I live right up the street from this location but would travel outside of my area the next time I would like to go to an applebees.  I would suggest you this location and go up the road to the Outback steakhouse or TGIF which is about less than a mile from this location.  I went to the Outback and the service and food were very good.

My goddaughter is transitioning into the vegan lifestyle and we were hanging out, so even though I'm not vegan I had no problem eating at Luhv, I enjoyed the chickpea tuna pita tasted so much like tuna and she said that was the best black bean burger she has had, she also purchased chickpea tuna, frozen sweet potato/jalapeño soup and pack of frozen black bean burgers to go. The staff was friendly and very pleasant. My son is already vegan but lives out of town, she is dying to take him to Luhv on his next visit home, like it was her who found this little diamond bistro

Had dinner there Saturday night and The food was unbelievable I can't believe I've lived here all my life and never went there we will be going back frequently Excellent service very very nice restaurant and you have to try the cannolis homemade by the owners daughter

We have eaten here for years and supported them during the quarantine with curb side pick up. We went to dine in yesterday on the 2nd day after they reopened. 90% of employees had their face mask around their neck or under their nose. That was a shocker. In the kitchen no one had a mask on. I don't want to get infected just for a good meal. They need some serious training on hygiene during this covid crisis.

Rarely rate a restaurant but felt it was my duty as a warning. Thankful to find something open while so many other restaurants but this one should have stayed closed. It was the blandest food I have ever eaten. The nachos literally had no taste except for the jalopenos. Even the steak added to it had no taste. A bowl of queso was brought out as a side to it, and there was some mild flavor to it which is why I'm bumping the review up to a one. No soft drinks on tap, it's cans of soda if you don't want beer.

Small-ish menu but let's be honest I keep coming back for the biscuits. They're soooo good and it's worth the 10ish mins or so wait for a made to order biscuit sammich. All of the items in the bakery case are seasonal and change often. They are all super delicious as well. But again, the biscuits have me coming back time and time again.

Love the family atmosphere and the food is always awesome. New management in the past few months. Keep up the great job. The weekly specials are excellent! I especially love fajita night. This is the place to get great food and relax with friends while you watch a great game or just to hang out.

Hmmm. It's a no for me. Heard of the place on Facebook as one of the best Black owned restaurants in Philly. Hoping to finally find a good barbecue place, but again was disappointed. Ordered the beef brisket platter. Beef was cut too think and I believe was an inexpensive cut of meat. It was very fatty and also tough. The meat was not seasoned and tasted bland. They put barbecue sauce  only on the top piece of meat. The barbecue sauce tasted like it was poured from the bottle. Honestly I had better at the chain Restaurant Famous Dave's. I will say that the potato salad was very tasty. The collard greens were tender and flavorful but had too much vinegar in them. I would go back for sides only. Only gave 3 stars because of the sides.

We go to Parts of Paris from time to time. Honestly the food is good, not outstanding, but the noise is deafening. We went to this bistro again and honestly I do not believe I will ever return. We arrived at our reservation time and were promptly seated. Actually we were given a choice of tables. The decibels were as anticipated with this nauseating high pitched person, beyond the control of the establishment, who thought everyone wanted to hear what she had to say. Not a place for a romantic candle light seductive evening. 
Our waiter came and we ordered wine and our meal.  1 hour later we still did not have any food on the table, not even bread. We told the waiter who said he would take care of this, but we neglected to ask when. My wife wanted to leave, but spoke to the owner who said that our food would be out soon.  She got the bone marrow, while I ordered the lobster. Her bone marrow was mediocre while my lobster was good. I did notice that the chef was servicing tables.  
30 minutes after finishing our appetizers, our entrees appeared. My wife got the duck, I ordered bone marrow, whose preparation was totally different from my wife's, which she ordered as an appetizer. Don't ask we could not figure that out either. I order potatoes au gratin because the waiter stated that my meal came without sides, which was incorrect. However, even had he been correct, their version of an au gratin was abysmal. I would not feed it to any animal. When I shared my comment with the wait

I'd say more of a 2-1/2.

Service is slow.   Food is good, but small portion size.  Margaritas are excellent.   Chips are good.  A bit pricey.

I wouldn't come back here unless I was desperate.   Slow service bugs the hell out of me.
Great food, even better people.  Grab a table here and feel like you're in a Florida cafe as the theme is Key West.  The "key" to this place is the southern hospitality!

I would give 10 stars for the excellent customer service here if I could. As someone who's worked in guest services for almost 20 years, Chick-fil-A is a model for how employees should be trained and treat their customers, in my opinion. Everyone here is always extremely professional and polite, with a "yes ma'am" and a "my pleasure" at the end of each sentence. Call me old fashioned, but I sure do appreciate manners when I'm out spending my time and money somewhere, especially nowadays when manners can be so hard to come by. I also like that this Chick-fil-A upholds the southern tradition of staying closed on Sunday, and that its menu mimics the original one even though we're on the west coast.

With that said, Chick-fil-A Reno does differ from the ones I used to frequent in the south. To be fair, I lived in Atlanta - the city where Chick-fil-A originated - so maybe they were held to a different standard. And I will say that the breakfast here is delicious. But every time I order lunch, I'm always left feeling "meh" about the meal afterwards. Something is different and I don't know what it is. I know this is a franchise, so I'm wondering if you all use the traditional peanut oil to fry your chicken and french fries? 

Additionally, the breakfast/lunch changeover from
10:15-10:30 is inconvenient. I understand it must be stressful for the busy staff as well. And I know I'm whining about first world problems, but I don't remember ever having to wait 15 minutes to order lunch at

Burgers r good- But 40 minutes to get the burger with an empty restaurant is unacceptable! First time I was here and it took 40 minutes- I thought I'd come back and try again. But alas. Another 40
Minutes! No burger is worth that!!! Goodbye Franklin Burger!‍
Fantastic food!  My favorite place for Mexican food!! Great service and the owners are always friendly and accommodating. Try the Pollo Loco it is the best!!
The Gumbo Empanada is the best one I've had. Chorizo is also great. The Cilantro Sauce and the hot sauce are both amazing. It's pretty expensive, but worth it.
Muy bonito lugar Perfecto para este tiempo frío tomarse un cafecito y digutar una rica areparecomendó

I basically just got robbed. I go to this place, all the way from New Orleans East, get the food, head home. Open the plate, no rice...half portion of steak which wasn't properly cooked. Ice cold veggies an 3 lobsters bites an 6 shrimp. I can't say what I want to say but this is pretty f***** Up. I spent 40 bucks. Couldn't even get a decent plate. I called an complained. Instead of them refunding my money, they told me when I come back I can get DOUBLE FRIED RICE 
I'm not driving 30+ miles for rice. 
I'll never go again an I dnt recommend anybody else going. One thing I hate is when folks can't honor when they screwed up. 
Ever since this pandemic started companies have been BEGGING people to spend money with them...for this??
Excellent Mom and Pop spot, PHO is delicious, I love it. Be patient cause when it is served you'll be thankful. Large quantity and great price.

I went in and asked the young girl Trystan to split the check between 2 cards. First she looks at us like she had no clue how to do it. Says why is there not enough money on one card. We say just split them on 2 checks. She acts like she did, doesn't say she couldn't or didn't. I looked the receipt and of course she couldn't do one simple request. I'm a cashier and know it's not difficult to do.

Friends of ours suggested we meet them at Apps and Tapps for apps and drinks since one of their favorite bands was playing there. We weren't too thrilled about the venue because of the poor ratings, but decided to go anyway thinking it's all about the company-how bad can it be. Well, we were proven wrong-the reviews had some truth to them. We found seats at the bar after being there for about 10 minutes. After waiting for about 40 minutes we got our first drink. ( Mind you we were sitting at the bar ). And, while we were waiting at the bar there were two people who didn't seem to working the bar were pouring shots for themselves to drink-assuming they were the owners. Anyway, with that kind of wait we didn't order any food. If it weren't for the good band we would have walked out.

This was (by far!) the best sit down dinner we had in our entire stay in Nashville.  It seems like every restaurant here has a 4.5 star rating, but this place actually earns it - the food was excellent. Cooked with skill and care from top quality local fresh ingredients, and serving sizes are fairly large. Prices are more than decent for the quality of food you're getting. Good service too. 

We had the shrimp and grits with Tasso ham gravy and the house made andouille and crawfish jambalaya and each was absolutely top notch, savory and delicious.  The house pickled assorted vegetable platter was tasty too. If you're visiting here from a serious food city and want something tasty, this is a great place to try.
Great food, doing the best in the current environment that I've seen in 6 states.  The atmosphere is great but the team effort and enjoyment of the staff make it stand out!

This was my first trip to this restaurant and I was not disappointed. I had the chicken satay which was fresh and excellent but a wee bit to spicy for me . When I mentioned this to the waitress she checked the rest of my order pad tai mixed seafood. When the dinner arrived it was perfectly cooked not one piece of seafood was over cooked each tender and delicious.4 star worthy. The waitress was friendly and at the end mentioned she was related to the owners. Fun all around

Drove here one evening after work, I thought I was getting a cold and craving Pho. It was SO GOOD! Definitely hit the spot. Spring rolls were a hit too. Fast service and good prices, will definitely be back!
This is the best cafe I have ever been too.  Everything I so delicious from the burritos to the toast!  LOVE IT!

I've only come once, and I became a huge fan of Bud & Marilyn's. It had really good reviews and was open for outdoor reservations, and I have to say it is one of the best restaurants I've been to recently.

Food/Drinks
This is honestly probably the best category about this place. We came at around happy hour, which is 4-6p on weekdays and 3-5p on weekends. They have $5 beer/mule/wine, which is pretty decent. We had the mules, which I had better (get something else). My friend and I ordered 1 of each "bun" from the happy hour menu (nashville hot chicken, korean glazed tofu, and shrimp po boy), which comes with 2 buns/order. THESE WERE AMAZING, and in order of goodness, nashville - shrimp - tofu. The buns were so buttery and the tastes were delicious! Attached some photos. Since the chicken bun was so good, we went ahead and ordered the nasville hot fried chicken as our main course, and this also did not disappoint and remains as one of the best fried chickens I've ever had. I can't wait to come back to eat again!

Ambiance/Environment
Good service, and very attentive servers. At this time, only outdoor seating is available given COVID, but they set up a rather large area of seating with multiple umbrellas that can cover "most" of the table (if it rains hard, you'll get wet). Bathrooms are inside, and the place actually looks rather nice and rustic. I'm disappointed now, but can't wait until it opens up! Parking is street parking, so it might be hard to find.

Rating: 9/10

This place is the real deal! Order the gyro and saganaki! It was a nice surprise to find authentic Greek food on our short trip to Collinsville.

Handmade pasta! Great sauces! High quality food! Everything is so fresh and delicious!! Create a pasta bowl. Get a meatball sub. I saw another reviewer say the prices were high?!? That is not true! The prices are great!! Wait til you try the pasta! You must go here :)
